patterns.note: The site uses a dynamic, asymmetrical image grid where images are freely placed and often overlap, creating a collage-like effect around and within large text elements.
Oversized, all-caps, wide sans-serif display text is used for main headings and section titles, contrasting sharply with minimal, thin sans-serif utility text.

Large display text elements dynamically change their accent color as the user scrolls through different sections, providing a visual cue for new content blocks against a predominantly white background.

Large display text elements (like 'ALBERTO OVIEDO' and subsequent project titles) exhibit a sticky or slow-scroll parallax effect, moving slower than the background content, and their color transitions as new sections enter the viewport.

Each major content block or project is introduced by a prominent, large text title that acts as a visual anchor, often spanning a significant portion of the screen and changing color with the section.

technique_notes: To rebuild the motion, large text elements should be positioned absolutely or fixed, with a slower scroll speed or sticky behavior, allowing background images and content to scroll underneath them. A scroll-triggered event listener would detect the current section in view and dynamically update the text color.
The layout involves a flexible grid or absolute positioning for images, allowing them to overlap and create a collage effect, with careful z-indexing to ensure text readability over images.
The typography system relies on a stark contrast between extremely large, bold, all-caps display text and small, thin, simple sans-serif text for navigation and supplementary information.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, wide, all-caps display headings (~8-10x body text) with minimal, thin body/utility text.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, dynamic, and asymmetrical, with images placed freely and sometimes overlapping text.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its dynamic, collage-like layout where oversized, color-changing, sticky text headings act as interactive section dividers, revealing a rich, asymmetrical grid of high-quality images as the user scrolls. It feels like an interactive art gallery or a curated digital portfolio.
